value.rationale: The invariant is motivated by the contemporary study of closed-neighborhood/Čech complexes of graph products. The exact first finite parameter at which homology concentration breaks is a natural boundary, not an arbitrary slice or a routine substitution in the existing Cartesian formula. An 18-vertex complex with 26,016 simplices (all dimensions counted with multiplicities once) has independent mod-two homology in adjacent degrees 4 and 5, providing a concrete reproducible test case for structural conjectures.
